CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linking to content organization/presentation/access is present.

COD.rationale: Identified content coordinates (C), presentation/organization statements (O) and origin metadata/status (D) co-occur for the same referents and time (current).

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content labels with attributes (red/blue) and coordinates are asserted in the report text.

D.rationale: Origin/presentation metadata (origin=... shown_at=12) is provided separately from the coordinate content claims, distinguishing content identity from presentation/status.

O.rationale: The report states organizational layout (rows/columns) and includes explicit origin/presentation metadata for the listed contents, describing how they are presented/accessed.
